premises: Coherent nanoprecipitates can be nucleated in a refractory HEA via a post-sintering heat treatment.
Coherent nanoprecipitates serve as potent obstacles to dislocation motion, increasing yield strength.
Coherency minimizes stress localizations that could lead to brittle fracture, enhancing ductility.
The proposed heat treatment (700–900 °C, 15–30 min) will produce fine, coherent precipitates without over-aging.
The treated alloy will show a 20–30% increase in yield strength and improved ductility over an untreated baseline.
